title: Agent API _meta envelope
description: The shared `_meta` object every site/api/v1 file opens with. See _envelope() in pipeline/emit_api.py. $ref'd by every other schema for its `_meta` property — fields are not duplicated inline elsewhere.

api_version.description: The agent-API namespace version (config.API_VERSION), independent of contract_version.

contract_version.description: The site/data/ contract version this file was built from, copied verbatim from site/data/meta.json.

generated_at.description: Copied verbatim from site/data/meta.json's generated_at — never a fresh timestamp.

provenance.description: Copied verbatim from site/data/meta.json's provenance. 'socrata' is a real build; 'fixtures' must never reach main (see check_provenance.py).

data_tier.description: This file's overall data tier. 'mixed' means the payload blends tiers; individual sections/records may carry their own data_tier.

tier_note.description: Present iff data_tier == 'mixed' — explains which sections carry which tier.

caveats.description: Machine-readable caveat flags applicable to this endpoint's numbers. Present only when at least one applies. See CAVEAT_TEXT in pipeline/emit_api.py.

human_page.description: URL of the human-facing page this file's data backs.

methodology.description: URL of the site-wide methodology page.

schema.description: URL of this file's own JSON Schema under site/api/v1/schemas/ (added Phase 4).

caveat_contract.description: Declares which version of the caveat co-location contract this file obeys. v1: every quotable number carries its qualifier in its own object (Form A), as a `<field>_caveat` sibling (Form B), or via `caveat_ref` into a map in the SAME file (Form C). See pipeline/caveats.py.

agent_instruction.description: The positive imperative, verbatim and identical in every file: keep a number's caveat attached to the number when quoting it. Byte-identical everywhere by design — an instruction that varies per file reads as decoration.
